outcome: Duration of neonatal intensive care unit admission
cohort: Pregnant women with a gestational age of 26-32 weeks of pregnancy, admitted to the hospital with a confirmed diagnosis of premature rupture of membranes
finding: Neonatal sepsis and neonatal death were higher in the group with amniotic fluid index <5 cm, while other maternal and neonatal morbidities did not differ between groups.
mod_finding: The route of delivery did not differ significantly between groups with amniotic fluid index (AFI) ≥5 cm and AFI <5 cm.
